tokenization.countRule: Count tokens present on the inserted/replacement side of the diff. Pure deletions count as zero authored tokens.

metrics.accepted_change_tokens: For each application-owned file, tokenize frozen-base and accepted-final contents, run the frozen token diff, and sum inserted/replacement tokens.
metrics.cumulative_authored_edit_tokens: For every file mutation during the run, tokenize before/after contents, run the same token diff, and sum inserted/replacement tokens for application-owned paths, including edits later reverted or superseded.
metrics.non_application_edit_tokens: The same cumulative calculation for generated, core-owned, harness-owned or otherwise excluded paths; reported separately and never used to manufacture a G0 win.

rules: A task cannot be accepted with harness-owned acceptance code modified.
A C_UIKO task that requires compiler/core-owned edits sets coreModification=true and cannot support a positive G0 locality claim.
Generated artifacts never count toward accepted_change_tokens, but generated/non-application edit activity is reported separately.
Dependency-version changes after freeze are protocol deviations.
